mentions.author: elvinyung
mentions.story: Ask HN: Any recommended resources to develop system thinking?
mentions.text:
A few cool reads in this area that are varyingly-related to software:

* Architecture of Open Source Applications ( [link]): always a nice reference for brief overviews of how various OSS projects are architected.

* Counterintuitive Behavior of Social Systems ( [course]): primarily an argument by Jay Forrester (the "father" of system dynamics) for using computer models to test social policy changes, but also serves as a primer for how systems are complicated, and how to approach reasoning about complex systems.

* A City Is Not A Tree ( [link]): ostensibly a paper about the structure of cities, but but really a deeper insight into the limits of using tree-like structures to describe…
